clusters.headline: MPR Verifies Amran and Sugiono as Candidates to Replace Gibran
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR is conducting factual verification of vice-presidential requirements for candidates Amran and Sugiono.
Candidates are scheduled for health examinations at the Gatot Soebroto Army Hospital to assess their suitability for the position.

clusters.headline: Total Of Twenty-Seven PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Victims Identified
aiSummaryBullets: Disaster victim identification teams have confirmed the identities of twenty-seven individuals following the fire at the Cikande facility.
Ongoing search efforts are currently being hindered by hazardous debris and unstable building structures at the factory site.

clusters.headline: MPR Discusses Vice President Election With Experts And Candidates
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR Ad Hoc Committee is finalizing the mechanism for the vice presidential selection process.
Eight legal experts including Mahfud MD and Hamdan Zoelva were invited to provide testimony regarding the appointment procedure.

clusters.headline: Brigjen Tedjo Kusumo Dismissed From Police Over Treason Case
aiSummaryBullets: Brigjen Tedjo Kusumo was dishonorably discharged from the Indonesian National Police following a professional code of ethics hearing.
Investigations allege the former officer orchestrated surveillance on government officials while serving as a Director of Intelligence in Densus 88.

clusters.headline: John Herdman Observes Players During Indonesia Training Camp In Bali
aiSummaryBullets: Head coach John Herdman is actively scouting players during the national team's training camp in Bali.
Dewa United defender Alta Ballah has been identified as a player under observation for a potential positional shift.

clusters.headline: BMKG Projects Rain Throughout Indonesia Amid Ongoing Weather Risks
aiSummaryBullets: The BMKG forecasts light rain across the majority of Indonesian regions on Wednesday.
The Jabodetabek area is expected to experience light rainfall according to current meteorological projections.

clusters.headline: Kejaksaan Agung Tugaskan 32 Jaksa Tangani Kasus Listyo Sigit Cs
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office has designated 32 prosecutors to oversee the legal files concerning former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo.
Bareskrim investigators identified a civilian suspect linked to the alleged illegal wiretapping operations conducted by Listyo Sigit and his associates.

clusters.headline: PSSI Confirms Committees As FFI Leadership Dispute Continues
aiSummaryBullets: PSSI has officially ratified the formation of the Election Committee and Election Appeal Committee for the Federasi Futsal Indonesia.
Michael Sianipar has expressed support for a PSSI-led audit concerning both state and non-state budget funds managed by the FFI.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Holds Two Hour Meeting With Dasco
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto and legislator Dasco conducted a private two-hour meeting at Merdeka Palace.
The discussion focused on how to effectively communicate public aspirations to the House of Representatives.

clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit Required To Attend Ethics Trial In Person On Thursday
aiSummaryBullets: Former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo is required to attend his ethics trial in person on November 26, 2026.
The ethics hearing concerns allegations of illegal wiretapping and treason directed toward President Prabowo Subianto.

clusters.headline: Erin Wartia Trigina Named Suspect And Reaches Settlement With ART
aiSummaryBullets: Rien Wartia Trigina was named a suspect in an investigation regarding alleged abuse of a former housekeeper.
The legal case initially carried a potential two-year prison sentence before both parties agreed to a settlement.

clusters.headline: Polri Fires AKBP Guntur Yayus Putra for Role in Alleged Treason Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police (Polri) has officially dismissed AKBP Guntur Yayus Putra from duty.
The dismissal follows investigations into his alleged involvement in a treason case and the unauthorized surveillance of government officials.

clusters.headline: Mendagri Tito Karnavian Tekankan Empat Komponen Pertumbuhan Ekonomi
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian identified household consumption, government spending, investment, and net exports as four key regional growth drivers.
The ministry aims to strengthen national economic conditions by fostering investment and promoting the export of products from micro, small, and medium enterprises.

clusters.headline: KPK Investigates BNPB Disaster Fund Corruption and Fee Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: The KPK is examining allegations of direct procurement and illicit fee payments involving disaster funds at the BNPB.
Investigators have called the wife and children of former BNPB head Suharyanto as witnesses, though they did not appear for questioning.

clusters.headline: Polri Names Six Suspects In Presidential Wiretapping Treason Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police have identified six suspects in the ongoing investigation regarding alleged treason and presidential wiretapping.
Bareskrim Polri is currently tracking the flow of funds amounting to hundreds of millions of rupiah linked to the activities of the suspects.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Discusses BTS Jakarta Concert With South Korean President
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto met with South Korean President Lee Jae Myung at the ASEAN Summit to discuss the upcoming BTS concert in Jakarta.
The third day of the BTS performance in Indonesia will be broadcast live across 2,800 cinema screens in more than 80 countries.

clusters.headline: Mendagri Tito Karnavian Urges Digital Child Protection Measures
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian highlights the importance of protecting children in digital environments.
The initiative is framed as a foundational step toward developing high-quality human resources for the country.

clusters.headline: Bekasi Mayor Tri Adhianto Questioned Over 2 Trillion IDR Gas Fraud
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office is investigating allegations of corruption involving an oil and gas operational cooperation between local firms and Pertamina EP.
Bekasi Mayor Tri Adhianto was summoned and questioned as a witness regarding the procedures used in the management of the operational contract.

clusters.headline: Pertamina Manages Fuel Subsidi and Distribution Amid Price Changes
aiSummaryBullets: Pertamina is increasing subsidized fuel supplies in Jayawijaya by 20 percent to accommodate seasonal demand before upcoming holidays.
The company provides guidance for users experiencing issues with QR-code blocks while accessing subsidized fuel services.

clusters.headline: Polri and BNN Intensify Anti-Drug Operations After Large Seizures
aiSummaryBullets: BNN dismantled a money laundering operation linked to a drug dealer identified as AA, seizing assets worth 57.7 billion rupiah.
Bareskrim Polri is intensifying surveillance at night entertainment venues to prevent potential spikes in drug activity during the New Year period.
